limitations: Actual successful-gate descriptor moves into the spawned task closure. Normal worker return releases its count before result publication; stage0 nonempty body destruction releases the same descriptor.
Join result-reader and worker executor are distinct installed vtable entries. Exact scheduler runtime, readiness helper and cancellation interleavings remain dependencies.
Existing acquisition and restoration-helper semantics are reused; waiter wake policy, semaphore source creation, native helper results and full RPC state isolation are not reconstructed.
No execution or emulation of the captured program. This is static ownership and dataflow evidence, not a runtime equivalence claim or complete backlog/component gate.
